query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN id IN (SELECT DISTINCT companyId FROM contacts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_contacts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesRepProfile IS NOT NULL AND salesRepProfile != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_sales_rep
FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
